category_title: Angry and confrontational youth prone to lashing out at teachers
scenario_title: Traditional classroom engagement and teacher interaction
minimal_context: Liam is sitting in a traditional high school classroom and is asked to complete a standard textbook assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Liam, please open your textbook and start working on the chapter questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. I don't even want to be in this place.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete the work if you want to pass.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Who cares? I'm pretty much a dropout anyway. I’m never going to get a job. I won’t be able to work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you don't try, you'll never make it outside of high school.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: F*** you and this stupid class! You all just treat me like a bad student anyway, so why should I even try?
